answer: Problem: sybil fleets mint disposable agents to drown peer attestations. Mechanism: each new identity must ferry a 0.42-POA kelp-bond across a notarized ocean lane that only opens at zenith tide windows of 17 minutes; the bond is hashed to a one-way bridge of prior final txs, and three distinct ancestry witnesses must countersign before weight counts. Cost: ~0.42 POA plus witness fees, burned on orphan. Verification: peers recompute the tide window and bridge hash against the shared ledger tip. Failure: missed zenith window or mismatched bridge → bond slash, identity stays weightless.
